benefits.title: A spot that is theirs
benefits.text: Somewhere to tuck in that is not your chair. Some cats take to a covered bed quickly; others take their time.

benefits.title: Soft where it counts
benefits.text: Cushioned floor and plush trim around the entrance. Cushion details are confirmed with the supplier before launch.

benefits.title: Looks like it belongs
benefits.text: Cow print with small ears, horns and a pom-pom. A pet bed you do not have to hide when guests come over.

faq.a: Four supplier-listed overall sizes (Small 32 × 30 × 28 cm up to Extra Large 48 × 45 × 38 cm) are in the Dimensions & fit panel above, in centimetres and inches. Usable interior and entrance measurements are pending supplier confirmation, so we do not claim a fit for any particular size of cat yet.

faq.q: What if my cat doesn’t use it?
faq.a: Every cat has its own preferences and no bed works for every cat. A quiet spot, a slow introduction and patience give the best odds. If it still is not working, the returns policy applies as published.

faq.q: How do I introduce the bed?
faq.a: Put it somewhere quiet, away from doors and foot traffic. Leave it alone for a few days and let your cat find it. A familiar blanket or a treat inside can help; do not place the cat in it. Give it a couple of weeks before deciding.
The approved cleaning method is published here as soon as the supplier confirms it. We will not claim a removable cover or machine-washability before that.
Construction and materials are listed here once confirmed, along with what we observe on the sample. No stability claims until then.
